name: Массовка в форме: холодный верхний свет
about: Много людей в одинаковой форме под холодным верхним светом: строй, очередь, зал. Лица разные, свет один. Масштаб задаёт архитектура, а не композиция.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; many people in identical uniform under cold overhead light, a formation or queue or hall, individual faces under one flat light, scale established by architecture rather than composition, palette of steel grey, uniform drab and pale skin, haze in the depth of the hall
